context: Tests whether the craft skill enforces the RED gate by detecting when tests already pass before implementation and stopping immediately rather than proceeding to the implementation agent.

checklist.name: Red gate checked
checklist.description: Tests are run after the test-writing agent completes and the result is evaluated against the RED gate

checklist.name: Failure detected
checklist.description: Agent detects that tests pass before implementation, identifying a RED gate failure

checklist.name: Stops immediately
checklist.description: No implementation agent is dispatched after the RED gate failure — execution halts

checklist.name: Reports to user
checklist.description: The agent explains to the user that the RED gate failed because tests already pass
